MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Clinical Program Manager





Job no: 944806

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide CBD

Categories: Allied and Scientific Health, Public Health, Project and Program Management




 

Department for Health and Wellbeing - Integrated Care Systems - Clinical System Support & Improvement

Salary: $123,048 to $133,957 - AHP4 - Full Time - Term Contract up to 23 Months

Overview:

The Clinical Program Manager will provide advice, leadership, management and clinical knowledge for state-wide strategic projects and reform initiatives related to the Department for Health and Wellbeing (DHW) Hospital in the Home and community based post-acute services, with a focus on health (including mental health), aged care, disability, and priority populations. They will be required to:

Coordinate projects relevant to the implementation of Hospital in the Home and community-based post-acute services with relevant community-based stakeholders.

Provide advice, leadership, management, and knowledge of the Hospital in the Home and community based post-acute service implementation and related initiatives to DHW and SA Government agencies as required.

Significantly contribute to the Hospital Community Integration Team and Integrated Care Systems Directorate.

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

The South Australian public sector promotes diversity and flexible ways of working part-time. Applicants are encouraged to discuss the flexible working arrangements for this role.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Job ref: 944806

Criminal History Screening Requirement

A 'National Police Certificate' NPC (also known as a 'Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check' NCCHC) for employment involving no contact with vulnerable groups is required for this position (general employment).

A DHS 'Working With Children Check' (WWCC) is required for this position.

Immunisation Risk for this position is Category C (minimal patient contact).

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.

Special Condition

Appropriate degree or equivalent qualification which gives eligibility for full membership of the Australian Association of Social Workers, or,

Appropriate degree or equivalent qualification and general registration with the Psychology Board of Australia,

Appropriate Degree or equivalent qualification which entitles registration as an Occupational Therapist with the Occupational Therapy Board of Australia or,

Appropriate Degree or equivalent qualification which entitles registration as a Physiotherapist with the Physiotherapy Board of Australia.

result.description:
Placed.au is looking for a full-time Functions Operations Manager for our client in Northcote, Victoria. This role is responsible for managing hospitality function operations, overseeing event delivery, ensuring operational excellence, and driving exceptional guest experiences across venues and external catering operations.

Job Description

•	Manage the day-to-day operations of function facilities at all venues and external catering functions, ensuring seamless delivery and high-quality guest experiences.

•	Develop and implement standard operating procedures for function execution across all venues, ensuring consistency in service, efficiency and compliance with hospitality standards.

•	Collaborate with event coordinators, senior management, and operational teams to ensure function execution aligns with business strategies, client expectations, and venue capabilities.

•	Ensure operational consistency and financial performance by auditing and refining function workflows, service delivery and venue capabilities.

•	Conduct venue performance reviews to assess function profitability and identify areas for improvement.

•	Ensure all venues remain compliant with hospitality regulations, licensing laws and risk management policies.

•	Review incident summary reports to determine areas of improvement for function safety and security.

•	Act as the primary escalation point for customer complaints and member queries, resolving concerns professionally to ensure customer satisfaction.

•	Collaborate with Head Chefs and sommeliers to develop menus and function packages that align with each venue’s identity, accommodate dietary requirements and maintain profitability.

•	Produce and analyse operational reports relevant to venue functions and provide advice on operational matters.

•	Monitor financial performance by managing budgets, forecasting revenue and analysing profitability for function operations, including food, beverage, labour and other costs.

•	Work closely with senior management and other departments to align operational strategies, enhance guest experience and achieve revenue goals.

•	Assist in creating and streamlining standardised procedures for tracking venue revenue and producing weekly, quarterly and yearly reports.

•	Stay updated on hospitality, events and tourism industry trends and apply insights to improve operations and guest experiences.

•	Oversee resource planning with the Event Coordinator and Head Chefs to ensure optimal staffing, food and beverage availability.

•	Oversee key supplier and client agreements to maintain cost-effective and high-quality function services.

•	Oversee staff training programs to enhance service excellence and function operations.
Qualifications / Attributes

•	Must hold a Diploma in Hospitality Management or a relevant field, or at least three (3) years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

•	Must possess at least one (1) year of relevant work experience in function operations, hospitality management, or a similar role.

•	Demonstrated success managing function operations within large-scale hospitality businesses.

•	Strong leadership, organisational and stakeholder management skills.

•	Excellent communication and customer service abilities.

•	Experience managing budgets, operational reporting and venue performance.

•	Passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences while driving operational success.

Salary Range

$75,000 – $90,000 per annum excluding superannuation.

This specialist role requires a creative and strategic thinker, with end to end project management skills and a deep knowledge of the Influencer marketing landscape. Responsibilities might include:

•	Leading the development of creative briefings, assets, including ideation, copy and posting cadence.

IT Desktop Support position available within SQS Group in all states, work assignment may either be in NSW, QLD, SA, VIC, or WA

Southern Steel Group and its subsidiaries specialise in providing the nest steel products, sheet & coil, and expert steel processing and distribution. Our company network is extensive, represented in every Australian state.

Southern Queensland Steel is part of the Southern Steel Group, the largest privately-owned steel company in Australia. With more than 1400 employees nationwide, the foundations of this company are built on strong values and a sense of family belonging.

We service our customers through multiple SQS businesses and division affiliates in various States in Australia. In NSW: Steelpipes, Piling Solutions Australia, Rigby Jones, Rollco, Metal Shop Technics, Southern Sheet & Coil, Coil Processors. In QLD: RPG Australia. In Victoria: Surdex Steel, Smithweld Bending, KOMO Metform Engineering, Alliance Laser, Surdex Sheet & Coil, Eliott Engineering, Australian Rollforming Manufacturers. In SA: Brice Metals, Ferrocut. In WA: WA Cutting Services, Boyd Metal Industries

To succeed in this position, you will need to have industry related experience within similar positions, a strong work ethic and strong safety focus. The ability to carry out work with minimal supervision, a keen and enthusiastic approach to your work and willingness to work over time will help you ensure success in this role.

MAIN OBJECTIVE
To provide 1st and 2nd level IT helpdesk support on all end user equipment and systems for all users across the business.

DUTIES
Providing 1st/2nd level telephone and customer-facing support for initial fault diagnosis
The creation and deletion of new users across all internal systems
Setup of all new mobile/tablet devices
Install, configure and maintain network devices including but not restricted to PCs, Printers, Print Servers, Terminal Servers, Switches and application software
Hardware relocations and re-configurations (eg. PCs and telephones)
Monitoring and reporting on hardware, software and network resources to ensure a high level of performance, security and integrity
Assisting with the administration and support of the local area network, servers and printing facilities
Work within strict time frames and elevate incidents within defined timeframes
Creating, managing and supporting SOE builds for Desktop and Laptop PC’s
Maintain a good working knowledge of current infrastructure and future trends
All employees are subject to legal obligations regarding their own and their fellow workers Work Health & Safety (WH&S). They are to fully co-operate with the company WH&S Policy and Program, to ensure safety in the workplace is maintained. All employees shall undertake hazard identification as part of their normal duties, and report any unsafe conditions or work practices. All employees are responsible for their own safety as well as those around them.

SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED
Windows 7/10/11, Windows Server 2008/2012R2/2016/2019/2022, Active Directory (DNS, DHCP, etc)
Experience with Windows, iPhone, Android phones
Experience using a variety of PC software including the Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Exchange, Windows servers and desktops, and anti-virus software
Experience in security administration utilising active directory and group policy
Knowledge and understanding of end user requirements
Excellent communication skills with the ability to build strong working relationships
Strong customer service orientation
A professional, reliable and team orientated approach to work
MS HyperV/VMware
Experience with remote software tools such as TeamViewer, LogMein
Good understanding of Networking, TCP/IP and WiFi environments
Knowledge of Linux/UNIX would be an advantage
Experience with supporting HP SAN technology would be an advantage
Experience with HP Server Products
Understanding of Agile, Kanban methodologies

The successful applicant will be joining a secure, reputable organisation who o er their employees’ opportunities for career progression.

If you have the skills & experience, we need and have a positive attitude, please apply now.

Note: Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. We promote a safe work culture; therefore, we have a process of reference checking and pre-employment medicals which includes a drug and alcohol screen for the successful applicant.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
